science.title: Microscopic Space Dust Reveals A Hidden Reservoir Of "Heavy Water" Beyond Neptune
science.description: Astronomers can find valuable information in even the tiniest objects. That was certainly the case recently when twelve dust grains collected by a high-altitude aircraft helped solve a mystery about the birth of our Solar System. Or at least that is the argument in a new paper published in Science Advances by researchers at NASA’s Johnson Space Center and UCLA. According to the paper, the region beyond Neptune once had a massive isolated reservoir of “heavy water” that never mixed in with the inner planets.

ai.title: Wall Street zigzags as Nvidia and other AI stocks keep swinging
ai.description: Wall Street is zigzagging as Nvidia and other AI stocks keep swinging on uncertainty about how much strength is left in their AI boom. The S&P 500 fell 0.1% Wednesday after flipping between gains and losses, coming off a four-day losing streak. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 575 points, while the Nasdaq composite rose 0.3%. Nvidia once again was at the center of the market’s moves. It initially jumped after delivering a better profit for the latest quarter than expected, but it quickly erased the gain and swung to a loss. Treasury yields eased after oil prices fell.

ai.title: Wall Street wobbles as Nvidia and other AI stocks keep swinging sharply
ai.description: Wall Street is wobbling, as Nvidia and other stocks tied to artificial intelligence keep swinging on uncertainty about how much strength is left in the AI boom. The S&P 500 rose 0.2% Wednesday after flipping between earlier gains and losses, coming off a four-day losing streak. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 231 points, while the Nasdaq composite added 0.8%. Nvidia once again was at the center of the market’s moves. It initially jumped after delivering a better profit for the latest quarter than expected, but it quickly erased the gain. Treasury yields held relatively steady as oil prices fell.
